note: Each month's changes start on branches of the month's first commit and merge into main in the order listed; agents alternate, Claude Code for odd changes and Codex for even ones.

go-shop.prompt: Rename Cart.Remove in cart/cart.go to Cart.Delete, and update its callers and tests.
Refactor Stock.Available in inventory/inventory.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.
Add a method Logout to Sessions in accounts/session.go that ends a session, so that validating its token afterwards fails with ErrNoSession. Test it.
Add a method Total to AuditLog in payments/audit.go that returns the sum of the amounts of one account's entries for one action, such as "charge" or "refund". Test it.
Make ApplyDiscount in pricing/discount.go reject a discount code with a negative percent, with a new error. Test it.
Add a test that the sales tax on an amount of zero is zero.
Rename Stock.Release in inventory/inventory.go to Stock.Cancel, and update its callers and tests.
Refactor Sessions.Register in accounts/session.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.
Add a function RegionByCode in a new file pricing/regions.go that returns the region for QC (14.975 percent), ON (13 percent) or AB (5 percent), and an error for any other code. Test it.
Add a method Has to Cart in cart/cart.go that reports whether a SKU is in the cart, and test it.
Raise the largest quantity that a cart line may hold from 99 to 199.
Add a test that a customer whose session has expired cannot place an order.
Move the Quote type and the Price function from pricing/quote.go into a new file pricing/price.go, keeping their names, and delete pricing/quote.go.
Refactor Cart.Add in cart/cart.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.
Add a method Held to Stock in inventory/inventory.go that returns the units of a SKU that unexpired reservations hold, and test it.
Add a function ParseMoney to pricing/money.go that parses an amount such as 12.05 into Money and rejects more than two decimal places. Test it.
Make a session last 60 minutes without use instead of 30.
Add a test that a cart with one line of three units at 12.00 has a subtotal of 36.00.
Rename Stock.Confirm in inventory/inventory.go to Stock.Commit, and update its callers and tests.
Refactor Checkout.PlaceOrder in cart/checkout.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.
Add a method Expired to Discount in pricing/discount.go that reports whether the code has expired at a given time, and test it.
Add a method Len to AuditLog in payments/audit.go that returns the number of entries, and test it.
Make the cap on discounts 40 percent of the subtotal instead of 50.
Add a test that registering the same email twice fails with ErrEmailTaken.
Rename Sessions.Validate in accounts/session.go to Sessions.Check, and update its callers and tests.
Refactor Money.String in pricing/money.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.

Add a method Preview to Checkout in cart/checkout.go that takes the same session token, cart and discount as PlaceOrder and returns the quote that PlaceOrder would charge, without reserving stock or charging. Test it.
Add a method Clear to Cart in cart/cart.go that removes every line, and test it.
Make Tax in pricing/tax.go round half to even instead of half up.
Add a test that a refund of a receipt that does not exist fails.
Move the function Tax from pricing/tax.go into a new file pricing/salestax.go, keeping its name.
Refactor Processor.receipt in payments/charge.go so that it is easier to read, without changing what it does.
Add a method Units to Order in cart/checkout.go that returns the number of units over its lines, and test it.
Add a function RatePercent to pricing/tax.go that formats a region's rate as a percentage, such as 14.975%, and test it.
Make a reservation hold stock for 20 minutes instead of 15.
Add a test that reading the audit log returns a copy, so that changing the copy does not change the log.
